analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing an issue where power cycling the [product_name] [article_no] device causes changes to the CSV output from its data logger, resulting in unusable files. This is a confirmed bug with this hardware revision, and since firmware updates are not supported for the affected units, users cannot apply any fixes. The bug undermines the reliability of data logging functionality on these devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect consistent and dependable CSV output from their data logger devices, regardless of power cycles. They are hoping for an official fix or at least a workaround, preferably through a firmware update, to address this bug.
